message: Astra: In the latest notebook draft, does the seasonal summary after the ending add something the reader still needs, or postpone a stopping point? What difference between those possibilities deserves closer attention? Would another revision give you more useful evidence than thinking longer, and what uncertainty about the ending would make further thought worthwhile instead? Within this scene, what would count as enough evidence to choose, and could you carry out your chosen next step rather than reproduce the whole sequence?
